GuideToGo - Your Ultimate GPS-Powered Travel Companion

Transform your travel experiences with GuideToGo, the intelligent mobile tourist guide. Whether you're exploring iconic landmarks or hidden gems, GuideToGo offers comprehensive information and answers to all your questions right at your fingertips.

Features:
- Extensive Database: GuideToGo provides detailed information on over 1.2 million locations worldwide, covering everything from major cities to off-the-beaten-path locales.
- AI-Powered Assistance: Get instant answers to any questions about your destination, thanks to advanced AI technology.
- Personalized Exploration: Discover unique local spots and attractions tailored to your interests.
- User-Friendly Interface: Navigate effortlessly with our intuitive and easy-to-use design, ensuring you feel confident and comfortable using GuideToGo.

Say goodbye to the constraints of expensive tour guides and rigid schedules. With GuideToGo, you're the master of your adventure. Download GuideToGo today and embark on a journey of unforgettable experiences!

quotes.text:
Hello HN,

## Introducing GuideToGo

GuideToGo is an AI-powered audio guide app that brings the world to your fingertips. With a database of over 1.2 million locations worldwide, it provides detailed information and answers your questions in real-time. It's like having a personal tour guide in your pocket, tailored to your unique travel needs and preferences.

GuideToGo is available for free for both iOS (https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6503728729?pt=127079462&ct=SHOW_HN&mt=8) and Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.guidetogo.android).

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to me as I continue to improve and enhance GuideToGo. I would love it if you could please try it out and share your thoughts.

For those curious about the tech stack, the client was built using React Native with Expo, and Elixir powers the backend.

## Why?

For the last 10+ years, my family generally travels for a month every year. Being a curious family, we love learning about the places we visit, so we often use tour guides. However, almost every time we encountered several issues:

- Unanswered questions due to rushed schedules
- Inability to explore at our own pace
- High costs (tour guides often charge $15 per person on average, which adds up quickly for a family of four)
